headline: Indian Markets Set for Muhurat Trading as Nifty 50 Enters Samvat 2083 Above 25,000 Mark

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Sensex and Nifty recorded a massive rally of over 1,700 points in the final sessions of Samvat 2082
Indian stocks posted their best weekly performance in six years, bucking a global technology sector rout
Strong festive demand is expected to drive Diwali trade to a record high of over Rs 7 lakh crore
Financial and auto sectors led the market surge, providing strong momentum for the new Hindu calendar year
whatHappening: NSE is conducting the traditional one-hour Muhurat Trading session to mark Diwali Laxmi Pujan
The Nifty 50 index enters the new Samvat 2083 year maintaining a position above the 25,030 level
Market participants are observing key support and resistance levels following a recent 2% rally in major indices
Domestic trade is seeing a significant boost from gold and electronics sales during the peak festive season
summary: Indian markets are set for the auspicious Muhurat Trading session as Nifty 50 enters Samvat 2083 above the 25,000 mark. This follows a powerful rally where the Sensex surged over 1,700 points, capping the best trading week in six years. Festive optimism is further bolstered by projections of record-breaking domestic trade exceeding Rs 7 lakh crore.
